{"id":"mimid-1wgh.37.90.48","title":"wg: combiner-02 L477 'can' does not make other combinations invalid","description":"draft-ietf-mls-combiner (combiner-02), Updating APQInfo. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-combiner at 380f0e1, L477.

Text: "A Commit can include either a single AppDataUpdate with a `full_update` or"

Problem: 'can' does not make other combinations invalid: a lone new_t_epoch, full_update plus new_t_epoch, duplicates, or an epoch update in a PARTIAL Commit. Under extensions-10 the application logic decides validity, so implementations can disagree, and the GroupContext then forks.

Suggested fix: State that, for 0x0006, the update list in one Commit MUST be exactly [full_update] or exactly one new_t_epoch and one new_pq_epoch, and that such updates MUST NOT appear in PARTIAL Commits. Any other list is invalid.

Severity: medium. Verifier: keep (Confirmed. Line 477 uses 'can', and extensions-10 Section 4.7 hands the validity of an update list to the application logic, so this draft must define which combinations are valid. Whether t_epoch changes on a PARTIAL Commit is also unstated.)
